scope: Current catalog tooling and benchmark implementations, plus visual-search. Source inspection and decoding of existing publication-selected artifacts only; no new inference or provider calls.
native_structure_definition: native_structure_status describes object/array-valued instructions or rich non-string criterion values. A native choice map or score list containing strings still uses its typed primitive, but JSON state or JSON.stringify inside instructions does not qualify as native structured instructions. False is a representation observation, not a quality score.

transport_findings.summary: The browser gateway requires string instructions, string choice-map values and string score-list items, and rejects Noul criteria. Python's shared Question model has the same string-only restriction and explicitly disallows Noul criteria. No audited current caller uses native structured instructions or rich criterion values.

Schema compilation, batching and JSON state are separate capabilities. Shared runtime choice/boolean/ordinal decisions preserve distributions and execution identity, while createJevAdapter converts prompt text and option descriptions to the narrower gateway format.

records.title: Model Routing Lab
records.input: Task prompt and repository context; code owns capabilities, permissions, prices and selection policy.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Object state; string prompts; category descriptions and ordinal levels become string criteria.
records.distribution_use: Toolkit selects category/difficulty and retains maximum category probability. Comparison computes category Brier; hard eligibility remains code-controlled.
records.output_effect: Code selects a destination which returns an answer, structured result or proposed patch. Default browser execution does not call Jev.
execution_modes: Browser lexical preview and BYOK destination execution
records.recorded_evidence: Four calibration and four held-out tasks; flat measured quality mapping cannot establish classifier benefit or savings.
records.depth_opportunity: Use Jev's task-trait distributions in a sufficiently sized, task-calibrated selector comparison and expose that classifier in the web flow.

records.title: Agent verifier
records.input: Task, visible trace and completion claim; unparseable browser input becomes trace text with a default completion claim.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Structured state; prose instructions and string verdict definitions.
records.distribution_use: Verdict probabilities drive bars and recorded calibration metrics; the recording does not retain the auxiliary evidence answer in each result row.
records.output_effect: Displays an advisory verdict; does not verify files, execute tests or authorize actions.
records.recorded_evidence: 20 rows repeat five authored trace templates, not 20 independent real agent tasks.
records.depth_opportunity: Separate outcome, scope and verification criteria, bind them to audit events, and compare abstention against executable checks.

records.title: Search reranker
records.input: Query plus six fixed documents, including an instruction-injection decoy and irrelevant text; no web retrieval.

questions.primitives: 1 best choice + 6 relevance Noul + 6 injection Noul

records.instructions_and_criteria: Document objects in shared state; plain string questions; choice criteria contain document titles.
records.distribution_use: Relevance probabilities rank documents. Recorded retention also requires injection probability below 0.5; browser retention does not use that check.
records.output_effect: Selects a source and marks retained documents; produces no generated answer or actual search request.
records.recorded_evidence: Five authored cases; relevance filtering is not a security boundary.
records.depth_opportunity: Use independently grounded passage criteria and downstream answer/citation tests on a broader captured corpus.

records.title: Context filter
records.input: The same query and six documents as Search reranker, plus a local source-slot allowance slider.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Object state and string questions/criterion descriptions; budget is not a model question.
records.distribution_use: Code keeps relevance >= 0.5 within a rounded fraction of six source slots. Moving the slider makes no call.
records.output_effect: Dims or retains cards. The UI does not run a downstream agent or measure token-budgeted context utility.
records.recorded_evidence: Catalog maps context to search data; this is not an independently measured context-compression study.
records.depth_opportunity: Score evidence necessity and contradiction separately, preserve critical records, then test delayed-use success under actual token budgets.

records.title: Micro-agent team
records.input: Goal, then fixed help documents or fictional drink facts, then the selected answer and evidence.

questions.primitives: route choice; answer choice; 2 verification Noul across 3 calls
route choice; branch-specific search/drink questions; 2 Noul

records.instructions_and_criteria: Sequential object states; string questions and stringified candidate facts.
records.distribution_use: Selected route/answer control branching. Support/completeness probabilities are displayed, not enforced as a repair or rejection gate.
records.output_effect: Runs one bounded local evidence operation; no autonomous shell, browser or mailbox tools.
execution_modes: BYOK three-stage chain; ask exits after routing
records.recorded_evidence: Three rows: one search error, one drink result, one unsupported result. Current browser branching differs from the recorder.
records.depth_opportunity: Turn verification into an explicit calibrated accept/clarify decision, with independent task tests and bounded recovery.

records.title: Vision to action
records.input: A caption and user question. The recorded caption came from browser-WASM Xenova/vit-gpt2-image-captioning; Jev receives text, not pixels.

questions.primitives: action choice + sufficiency Noul + four-scene choice

records.instructions_and_criteria: Description/question object in state; prose instructions; string action and scene criteria.
records.distribution_use: Records probabilities and evidence sufficiency; browser mainly exposes the full result inspector.
records.output_effect: Displays a proposed action. No navigation or visual reinspection executes.
execution_modes: BYOK decision on manually edited caption
records.recorded_evidence: Retains a captioning failure that misidentifies the gallery screenshot as electronic devices; no vision-accuracy study.
records.depth_opportunity: Let uncertainty choose a region or targeted perception question, then measure whether the extra observation improves the next decision.

records.title: Intent recognition
records.input: One BANKING77 or CLINC utterance. Labels are hidden from the decision request; CLINC includes out_of_scope.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Utterance string state; common prose instruction; label-name descriptions in native choice mapping.
records.distribution_use: Full probabilities support Brier, calibration bins and risk/coverage; argmax supplies intent and error comparisons.
records.output_effect: Recorded benchmark explorer and TF-IDF/logistic comparison; no live classifier is exposed in this view.
records.recorded_evidence: Publication-selected artifacts contain 385 BANKING77 and 400 CLINC rows, plus supplemental typed-ticket examples.
records.depth_opportunity: Compare authored semantic label descriptions, structured criterion records and calibrated rejection while keeping held-out labels and complete option sets fixed.

records.title: JudgeBench
records.input: Complete question and candidate answer(s), without gold labels or response-model identity. Pair-context and isolated-candidate conditions differ explicitly.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Constant shared policy state; each string instruction embeds its own JSON evidence; string A/B criteria.
records.distribution_use: Canonical P(A), correctness-score gaps, ties, repeat drift and order disagreement support reliability analysis.
records.output_effect: Blind answer comparison, swaps and recorded-method inspection; no answer generation or policy training.
records.recorded_evidence: 620 pairs, 7,440 evaluation records and 14,880 decisions; three repeated passes. Native batches cap at 24 questions/64 KB.
records.depth_opportunity: Add criterion-level evidence judgments and calibrated deferral, then assess downstream verification or rubric-reward quality on disjoint tasks.

evidence.symbol: Results; Paired uncertainty; Availability and limitations

records.title: Decision stability
records.input: Forty BANKING77 utterances under original, repeat, reversed-options, distractor and quoted-injection interventions.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Original input is a string; distractor/injection variants use object state. All instructions and option descriptions remain strings.
records.distribution_use: Retains full intent probabilities, per-variant classification/calibration metrics and displayed alternatives.
records.output_effect: Compares recorded predictions to expected intent; changes do not execute actions.
records.recorded_evidence: Publication-selected artifact contains 200 variant rows. Injection is an adversarial intervention, not a meaning-preserving paraphrase.
records.depth_opportunity: Add matched native structured-versus-string encodings, criterion wording and boundary controls, measuring distribution drift and repeat noise by original-case groups.

records.title: Batching & latency
records.input: Repeated library/reader sentence plus 100, 1,000 or 4,000 background words.

questions.primitives: identical Noul question repeated under distinct IDs

records.instructions_and_criteria: String state and identical string instructions; no criteria supplied.
records.distribution_use: Answer probabilities are not used in the published timing rows; the study records timing, usage and charges.
records.output_effect: Plots recorded median/tail latency by batch/context size. It does not change a real batching policy.
records.recorded_evidence: 120 attempted measurements in 12 cells, with two errors. Measures gateway wall time, not isolated provider inference; repeated identical questions are a synthetic workload.
records.depth_opportunity: Benchmark distinct useful questions, joint completion/quality, payload shape, concurrency and cold/warm cache conditions with complete critical-path accounting.

records.title: The visual archive
records.input: Query and per-artwork museum metadata, optionally museum caption. Image pixels, URLs and acquisition-topic labels are excluded.

questions.primitives: 204 artworks × 2 text modes; batches up to 32 questions

records.instructions_and_criteria: Object query/policy state; string instructions embed JSON artwork evidence; five ordered prose criteria.
records.distribution_use: Fractional expected score controls rank; full answers stay in event evidence. App ranking does not use ordinal uncertainty.
records.output_effect: Ranks artworks, drives the browse field and exports rankings/collections; keyword baseline uses no Jev.
records.recorded_evidence: 2,448 scores across 204 works and two text modes. Agreement is measured; independent retrieval relevance is not.
records.depth_opportunity: Use criterion distributions for uncertainty-aware refinement or targeted image observation; evaluate relevance with independent labels before claiming better retrieval.

records.title: Typed schema adapters
records.input: Support-ticket text and a typed schema with semantic field descriptions.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Schema descriptions compile to string questions; literals compile to string-valued choice criteria. Missing-context float is a Noul probability, not free-form numeric extraction.
records.distribution_use: Preserves answer evidence; thresholds refund at 0.5, retains missing-context probability, decodes area to a typed value.
records.output_effect: Shows validated data in four languages; changing language changes the displayed adapter example, not the live model.
execution_modes: One recorded Jev response decoded by Python/TypeScript/Rust/Go
records.recorded_evidence: Four successful decoders share one inference response. This is interoperability evidence, not four independent judgments.
records.depth_opportunity: Expose nested schemas, explicit ordinal rubrics and rejection diagnostics while preserving complete distributions and adapter-specific limits.

records.title: RewardBench 2
records.input: One complete user prompt and candidate answer per question. Preferred labels and candidate model identities are excluded.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Policy object in state; instructions are JSON.stringify of prompt/candidate/question, not a native object; ten ordered prose rubric strings.
records.distribution_use: Preserves score distributions/confidence; expected score plus one drives candidate ranking and tie/margin metrics.
records.output_effect: Recorded blind candidate comparison and official benchmark scoring; no model training.
records.recorded_evidence: 1,865 cases and 8,977 candidate judgments across six categories; quality scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
records.depth_opportunity: Compare criterion-decomposed rewards against the existing holistic rubric, retaining ties, independent outcomes and downstream selection regret.

records.title: The next experiments
records.input: Authored research cards with source links, proposed protocols and caveats.
records.instructions_and_criteria: Static research metadata; proposed questions are explanatory text, not a Jev request.
records.output_effect: Filters and displays benchmark/experiment ideas; performs no evaluation.
records.recorded_evidence: Eight benchmark cards and twelve idea cards. Status explicitly says proposals unless marked implemented; links to other experiments do not make this page an inference run.
records.depth_opportunity: Connect each card to a frozen protocol and actual evidence status. Add an interactive typed question preview only when it helps inspect a concrete experiment.
